technique_name: Compose an essay answering the following prompt: What are the main differences between a cat and a dog?
description:
The main differences between a cat and a dog can be seen in their physical characteristics, behavior, and personality. 

Physically, cats and dogs differ in many ways. Cats are smaller than dogs and have a long, flexible body and a slender tail. They do not have as much physical strength as dogs, but they can jump and climb greater heights than dogs, even to the top of a very tall tree or a building.
